serving.notes: This repo has no generation_config.json and no adapter_config.json. config.json sets max_position_embeddings to 40960, torch_dtype bfloat16, unsloth_fixed true, and unsloth_version 2025.11.4. The chat template accepts a system message when the caller supplies one and has no fixed medical system prompt. The text-only quote is the parent card's usage example (Qwen/Qwen3-4B); this card has no usage example. The parent card says the native context is 32,768 and that 40,960 in config.json reserves 32,768 tokens for outputs. The parent card states 4.0B parameters; the safetensors header counts 4,022,468,096. The MedicalLms collection sentence mentions radiological images from the PMC Open Subset, but that collection also holds a vision model, and this card names only the two text datasets.
